meta.name: doc-evidence-compare
meta.description: Compare repository documentation and code evidence for a topic, check whether a business rule or relationship is documented, locate implementation evidence, and identify mismatches or missing documentation with file-backed conclusions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比对文档与代码，发现不一致或缺失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需确认文档是否准确反映代码实现
copy.tagline_en: Compare docs and code to find mismatches or gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to verify documentation matches code implementation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会同时搜索仓库的文档和代码，对比某个业务规则或功能是否在文档中有记载、在代码中已实现，并指出不一致或缺失的地方，最后给出带文件引用的结论。
howto.when: 当你询问文档与代码是否一致、某个规则是否已实现、或代码中某功能在哪实现时触发。

say.text: 检查用户注册流程在文档和代码中是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会搜索文档和代码，输出证据矩阵。

say.text: 这个支付规则在代码里实现了吗？文档有没有写？
say.note: Claude 会对比文档和代码，给出状态分类。

say.text: 帮我找一下订单超时逻辑的代码位置和文档说明。
say.note: Claude 会定位实现并检查文档覆盖。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude searches both documentation and code in the repository, compares whether a business rule or feature is documented and implemented, identifies mismatches or missing documentation, and outputs file-backed conclusions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask whether docs and code are consistent, whether a rule is implemented, or where a feature is implemented in code.

say_en.text: Check if the user registration flow is consistent between docs and code.
say_en.note: Claude will search docs and code, output an evidence matrix.

say_en.text: Is this payment rule implemented in code? Is it documented?
say_en.note: Claude will compare docs and code, classify each claim.

say_en.text: Find the code location and documentation for the order timeout logic.
say_en.note: Claude will locate implementation and check doc coverage.
